# Work Humanizer

Rewrite AI-sounding work writing so it reads like a careful person wrote it, without changing what it says or commits to: sales and marketing copy, support replies, HR and legal letters, emails, docs, release notes and posts — rewriting your draft fresh from its fact list, or, in interview mode, asking up to five sharp questions and building the piece from your own notes and words, then auditing every fact sentence by sentence.
